meta.title: Fiverr Niche Fetcher
meta.description: Search and analyze Fiverr gigs to discover niche opportunities. Includes tools for searching gigs, fetching detailed info, and running the full crawl pipeline.

tools.name: search_fiverr_gigs
tools.description: Search Fiverr for gigs matching a niche keyword and return ranked search-card metadata: title, seller name/level, rating, review count, starting price, thumbnail URL, sponsored/organic rank position, and badges. No Fiverr account required.

niche.description: Search keyword or niche, e.g. 'logo design' or 'python web scraping'.

limit.description: Maximum gig cards to return (1-500). Default: 20.

max_search_pages.description: Maximum Fiverr search pages to scan (1-30). Default: 5.

tools.name: fetch_gig_details
tools.description: Fetch and parse a single Fiverr gig detail page. Returns comprehensive gig title, seller info, pricing packages, FAQs, reviews, related tags, and metadata. No Fiverr account required.

tools.name: crawl_fiverr_niche
tools.description: Run the complete two-stage Fiverr crawl pipeline: search + fetch all gig details concurrently. Returns merged results with search-card metadata and full gig details plus crawl statistics. Rate-limited and polite by default.

limit.description: Maximum gigs to crawl end-to-end (1-50). Default: 10.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds between individual gig fetches (0.5-10). Default: 2.0.
